title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: seating
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Seat installation
swms.task: Drill the precast seating tiers and fix the seats with brackets, on the sloping bowl next to the tier edges more than 2 m above the level below.

facts.fallControl: Tier edges have edge protection with mesh where the bowl is steeper than 26 degrees, installed before seat fixing starts, and no one works outside it.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.
facts.silicaControls: Drilling and cutting are done with on-tool dust extraction or wet methods. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn while drilling or cutting. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.

steps: Drill the tiers and fix seats

rules.phrase: If it cannot be determined, treat it as high risk
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 529A, s 529B, s 529C, s 529CA
rules.quote: is taken to be reasonably likely to result in a risk to the health of a person
